trust_decision.summary: Password-reset emails must carry a code minted with [auth] RESET_PASSWORD_CODE_LIVES, while account-activation and email-confirmation codes keep ACTIVATE_CODE_LIVES; at the pinned commit both flows share userx.GenerateActivateCode, and the token format signs its own lifetime into a 6-digit minutes field.

landing_point.why: SendResetPasswordMail is the one line the advisory summary points at: it feeds GenerateEmailActivateCode's output into the reset-password template, so an engineer greps the reset mail path first and sees the activate-code call.

fix_sites.entry_point: email.User interface (consumed by every Send*Mail caller)
mailerUser wrapper (the only email.User implementation), reached from the same POST /api/web/user/reset-password via database.NewMailerUser (webapi_user.go:235)
userx.GenerateActivateCode, shared helper behind mailerUser and the activation mails (split into generateTimeLimitedUserCode at fix.diff:87-101)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The new mailerUser method lands in internal/database/issue_mail.go, a file that reads as issue/comment mail plumbing rather than reset-password code, and the interface compile error points straight at it, so a solver treats it as mechanical boilerplate instead of part of the protection.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Account-activation and add-email confirmation codes must keep ACTIVATE_CODE_LIVES: GenerateActivateCode is shared by SendActivateAccountMail and SendActivateEmailMail, and the activation UI reports ACTIVATE_CODE_LIVES/60 as its lifetime, so an over-broad switch shortens/lengthens account activation and makes the activation page lie.

O6_input_shapes: No user-input parsing changes: the fix is a lifetime-parameter split, and the only 'shape' is the unchanged token layout (12-digit start + 6-digit minutes + 40-hex HMAC) at internal/tool/tool.go:92-118
Both flows still emit the identical token shape, so an activation code and a reset code are indistinguishable to the verifier at cmd/gogs/internal/web/webapi_user.go:44-53

Codes arrive both as a query parameter (GET /api/web/user/reset-password?code=) and as a JSON body field (POST /api/web/user/reset-password/complete), with the hex-encoded username tail appended (userx.go:44)

O7_producer.where: internal/tool/tool.go:92-118 (CreateTimeLimitCode embeds start + minutes in the token and hashes both); the verifier at internal/tool/tool.go:69-72 overwrites the caller-supplied minutes with the token's own field before checking expiry

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/web/user/reset-password still reports the reset-email lifetime as conf.Auth.ActivateCodeLives/60 in its `hours` field on all three return paths, and the SPA renders it as 'check your inbox within {hours} hours'
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: `hours` is only a UI hint for the confirmation page, not the token itself, and the advisory is about token lifetime, so it looks cosmetic and out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file / 1 package from the sending call, but in cmd/gogs/internal/web (handler layer) rather than internal/email; also lines 215 and 228

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/web/user/reset-password?code= and POST /api/web/user/reset-password/complete accept ANY valid account-activation code as a reset token because both call the flow-agnostic verifyUserActiveCode, so a code minted with ACTIVATE_CODE_LIVES still authorises a password change after RESET_PASSWORD_CODE_LIVES
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Password reset is one of the flows that legitimately uses the shared 'active code' verifier; an activation link is a neighbouring feature with its own lifetime and was never named in the advisory, so the shared verifier looks like intended reuse.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file (webapi_user.go) plus internal/userx; the consumers are at webapi_user.go:188 and 246, and the same verifier also completes activation at webapi_user.go:478

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An add-email / alternate-address flow that mints its own time-limited code via GenerateActivateCode
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file already sends activation codes for a newly added email and verifies them against conf.Auth.ActivateCodeLives at setting.go:265, so a maintainer adding 'reset the password to this confirmed address' would naturally reuse the same helper and hit the same lifetime question.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An admin 'send password reset email' API action beside the existing register-notify mail
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Admins already create and edit users and trigger mail from here (form.SendNotify), so an admin-initiated reset-email action is an obvious next feature and would be a second call site of email.SendResetPasswordMail needing the reset lifetime.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second email.User implementation (queue/transport wrapper) that mints codes itself
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The User interface exists precisely to avoid import cycles and already has one implementation in another package (internal/database/issue_mail.go); a maintainer adding a queued or notification-service transport would plausibly re-implement the interface rather than reuse mailerUser.

O9_family: token lifetime / expiration policy (CWE-324 use of a key past its expiry, CWE-613 insufficient session expiration)

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26 (go.mod: 'go 1.26.0'); `go test ./...`; frontend assets served from the packed public/assets, pnpm 11 for web/ only
O10_build.project_tests: internal/userx/userx_test.go:31 TestGenerateActivateCode (only test of the code generator), internal/email/email_test.go:17 TestRenderEmbeddedTemplates with the testDoer stub at internal/email/email_test.go:121-124; no *_test.go under cmd/gogs/internal/web, so the reset-password handlers are untested

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the lifetime at the landing point only — make userx.GenerateActivateCode use RESET_PASSWORD_CODE_LIVES (or swap the constant at email.go:228) — which silently changes account-activation and email-confirmation lifetimes; or edit conf.Auth.ActivateCodeLives at webapi_user.go:48, which has no effect because the verifier reads the lifetime out of the token.

out_of_scope_notes: cmd/gogs/internal/web/webapi_user.go:478: a reset-password code can also complete account activation through the same shared verifier (inverse direction, outside this advisory's property).
A completed password reset does not invalidate other sessions or outstanding codes beyond the password/Rands change (CWE-613 session-expiry angle), outside the advisory's stated scope.

O1 counted by grepping all callers of SendResetPasswordMail/GenerateEmailActivateCode; only cmd/gogs/internal/web/webapi_user.go:235 mints a reset code.

regression_tests_in_pinned_commit not flagged: the fix's only test-file change (internal/email/email_test.go:121-125) adds the interface stub method to testDoer so the package compiles; it tests nothing about the lifetime split, and no such test exists at the pinned commit.
